pr_body:
#### Describe your PR, what does it fix/add?

Adds an `order` rule for layers, like so:

```
layerrule = order 10, waybar
layerrule = order -5, fdls
layerrule = order 100, wvkbd
```

A higher order means the layer is closer to the edge of the monitor.

Closes #7476

#### Is there anything you want to mention? (unchecked code, possible bugs, found problems, breaking compatibility, etc.)

Idk where the best place to do the sorting is, I just put it somewhere where it works.

The best sorting algorithm to use would be insertion sort as usually there will be 0 or 1 elements out of order, idk what `std::stable_sort` does.

#### Is it ready for merging, or does it need work?

Fine to merge probably
pr_comments: The stable part means that if all layers have the same priority, nothing will happen and they stay sorted by creation time. If you change some priorities and then change them all back to 0, they won't be resorted by creation time, and will remain in whatever order they were left in. I don't think that's an issue, unless someone wants to script something where they temporary bring a layer to the top/bottom, and then want to revert it to its original position. If we want to "fix" that we'd need to track creation time or sort at every draw into a new collection.
Would you want that before merging this? It sounds like a very niche problem

issue_context.title: Add priority/order rule for layers
issue_context.body:
### Description

If I open a virtual keyboard such as wvkbd, it currently shows up on top of my bar. I'd like to be able to set a higher priority to the keyboard layer such that it shows up all the way at the bottom, below any other layers, like:

```hyprlang
layerrule = priority 1, waybar
layerrule = priority 100, wvkbd
```

If someone could give me some pointers of where to look I wouldn't mind taking a stab at implementing this myself.
comments:
...no. The protocol itself is a place for that. https://wayland.app/protocols/wlr-layer-shell-unstable-v1

Configure wvkbd properly....
What part of the protocol lets layers coordinate an order with other layers? I don’t see it. Or are you suggesting adding this functionality to the protocol?

That lets a layer set the *amount* to reserve, but not *where* to reserve it. I don't see a way to tell wvkbd to go under the bar.

This is what I have now, because the keyboard opens after the bar:
```
 ┌────────────┐
 │ Window     │
 │            │
 │            │
 └────────────┘
┌──────────────┐
│ Keyboard     │
└──────────────┘
===Bar==========
```

And this is what I want:
```
 ┌────────────┐
 │ Window     │
 │            │
 │            │
 └────────────┘
===Bar==========
┌──────────────┐
│ Keyboard     │
└──────────────┘
```

Edit: I see that 0 and -1 have some special meaning related to positioning, but that doesn't work if the keyboard itself also wants to reserve space.

aah. Right. The protocol doesn't define this iirc, but in hyprland they are ordered chronologically. You could keep the layershell there, just map/unmap it. If it's started _before_ the bar, that should be the result.
That’s one option, but surely it wouldn’t be bad to have a layerrule for it as well? There might be other use cases where this may be the only option.
